title: Implement -ing-form and article checks
description: Add checks for -ing verb forms outside approved technical nouns (e.g. casing, fitting) and for missing articles, with allowlists for headings, code spans, and frontmatter via the existing masking helpers.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented asd_ing_form (dictionary ingNouns allowlist + technical-name spans) and asd_missing_article (noun-initial sentence heuristic, unknown-POS words skipped). Dictionary extended with verbs and ingNouns seeds. Full suite green: 191 pytest, 34 behave features / 104 scenarios, 6/6 evals.
